title: PermissionRequestParams
description: S→C notification: a tool call is awaiting user approval (`Ask` decision).

args.description: Raw tool arguments (contains `cmd` for bash, `path` for file tools).

origin_client.description:
Connection id of the client that initiated the run (design 决策 #5).
Absent in single-client (stdio) mode — additive.

reason.description: Human-readable reason (tool default mode / matched rule).

request_id.description: Opaque id decoupled from the JSON-RPC request id (like $/progress token).
